mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts growth and industrial production decline signal sectoral imbalance where housing overheats while manufacturing weakens, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 90 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings visibility, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth deceleration and unemployment rate rise indicate labor market deterioration that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts above 500 thousand units signal sustained consumer confidence that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 500 during late-cycle expansions.
